scope: Fixed upward Propeller Bearings, symmetric centered quad, configured sail counts; not detected from Link

formulas.sailPower: sum 1 per WINDMILL_SAILS block; COPYCAT_PANEL resolved to non-air Material first
formulas.effectiveRPM: abs(rotationSpeed * 3.3333333); rotation target = inputRPM * 0.3; thrust direction separately verified

limitations: Sail count is configured, not read from an actual rotor
No assembly/direction/shaft ACK from wireless command
No off-center geometry or tilt actuators
Heterogeneous counts and extreme inertia/delay/travel cases have remaining simulation failures
